In the third year of their partnership, Torrhen began teaching Zephyr the Deep Tongue—the language that existed before words, the harmonic frequencies that could reshape reality through pure sonic resonance.
But slowly, through countless failures and gradual successes, Zephyr learned to quiet his calculating mind long enough to hear the deeper harmonies.
The Deep Tongue flowed from his consciousness like liquid starlight, frequencies that made ice dance, stone sing, air itself become visible through harmonic resonance.
Not free from limitation, but free within it.
Not free from the mathematics of existence, but free to dance with those mathematics, to shape them through harmony rather than dominate them through force.
